integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo standard GL finite-frame completeness; code gives finite corroboration, not independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Constant-generation dichotomy only, for ordinary □ and ◇ over GL; general type C closure remains open. Full text of Rata–Rusu (2000) was inaccessible and could contain equivalent results.
title: A self-duality dichotomy for constant generation in Gödel–Löb modal fragments
